title: Effect Shop
description: A GUI shop where players spend experience levels to buy temporary potion effects.
body:
Effect Shop is a Paper plugin that lets players spend experience levels to buy temporary potion effects through a simple GUI. Open the shop with `/eshop` and choose what you need.

## Effects

| Effect | Max level | Cost |
|--------|-----------|------|
| Haste | II | 30 / 60 lvl |
| Strength | II | 40 / 90 lvl |
| Night Vision | I | 25 lvl |
| Fire Resistance | I | 40 lvl |
| Invisibility | I | 200 lvl |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/eshop` | Open the Effect Shop |

> Permission: `eshop.use` (default: all players)

## Configuration

All effects, prices, durations, and GUI layout are configurable via `config.yml`.

## Installation

1. Drop the `.jar` into your `plugins/` folder
2. Restart the server
3. Use `/eshop` in game

## Requirements

- Paper 1.21+
- Java 21+
